example_projects.title: Tessera codelab
example_projects.description: A hands-on introduction to building a verifiable log with Tessera. Walks through implementing the core operations needed for a tile-based transparency log.

example_projects.title: POSIX example log
example_projects.description: A simple example of a Tessera-based log using a POSIX filesystem as storage. A great starting point for understanding how to build with Tessera.
